notes.title: If you lost, how to find the way? and how to reach to the "true ending"?
notes.content: [h3][b]<! spoiler alert !>[/b][/h3][p]If you lost the way,  see these pics below. [/p][p]notice: if you want to discover yourself, please close this page.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]to Memory 12[/b][/h3][p]after clearing Memory 11, go down in the Story Tree (first area) and use the skill Karma and unlock the door.[/p][p]Then down, down...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43720042/17f25f034068805289fd6465cb0e6dcfa4cf8ed3.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]skill item in Memory13[/b][/h3][p]It's a better to get the 'skill item' in Memory 13.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]to Memory 16[/b][/h3][p]after clearing Memory 15,  the small gate next to 15 will be activated and entering it. You will be placed on the above on Memory 11 and can climbing the [b]hidden ladder[/b] (floating sparkle).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43720042/afc54ab07a256d6eaf36d997281cdab83105e52e.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]to Memory 17[/b][/h3][p]after clearing Memory16, use the Wing Skill (long press button) to fly upward and proceed to Memory17.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43720042/ad242628bb3f69201a5fa8475c7244a53928f2ae.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]to  the * True ending *[/b][/h3][p]after clearing Memory 17, revisit  "[b]Memory 0[/b]". [/p][p]☁☁☁ ☁☁ ☁[/p][p]the true ending is 'above' there (double jump!)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]if you have any question, comment to the thread of [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2328380/discussions/0/3809531933805722329/"]Feedback[/url][/h3][h3]and also waiting your [b]review[/b]!! ːsteamthumbsupː[/h3][p]Daiyu[/p]

notes.title: DLC.1 free patch ✨ (this special benefit has terminated)
notes.content:
The Early Access version you purchased,
[b]already contain DLC.1[/b] which will be sold separately at the time of main release.
[b]You will need to register your activation[/b] with this patch.

Procedure:
(1) update to the latest version v2.6.1~.
(2) Start up the game and enter Story or Traveling mode.
(3) Go back to the Main menu, then you will see a pink "DLC1" sign on the right.

Please do this by the end of February 2024.
